title: A missing required secret fails boot loudly; a missing optional secret returns null
iWant: the process to name the missing secret and stop, not stagger on
soThat: diagnosis is one step and there is no half-alive state serving traffic

acceptanceCriteria.description: A boot with a required manifest entry unresolvable in the active environment aborts with a stable-coded error and does not open any listening port.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest entry `R` with `required: true` where the vendor returns not-found for the active environment path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process exits with a stable-coded `SECRETS_REQUIRED_ABSENT` error naming `R` and the active environment, and a subsequent port scan on the process's declared listen ports returns closed on every port

acceptanceCriteria.description: A boot with only optional manifest entries unresolvable proceeds and serves those names as null.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a manifest entry `O` with `required: false` where the vendor returns not-found for the active environment
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and a caller invokes `secretsClient.get('O')`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process comes up normally, the call returns null, and no `SECRETS_REQUIRED_ABSENT` error is emitted

acceptanceCriteria.description: The client does not retry-on-loop for a required-absent secret at boot; the failure is single-shot.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a required manifest entry that will never resolve
acceptanceCriteria.when: boot runs against instrumented vendor code that counts read attempts for that entry
acceptanceCriteria.then: the read is attempted once (plus any vendor-level automatic retry the SDK does internally within a single call), the process exits, and the read counter is one
